verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
[✲]By the stemless plant when it falls,
Your companion has neither erred, nor has he gone astray,
Nor does he speak out of his own desire.
It is nothing but pure revelation that has been revealed by God.
The Lord of mighty powers has taught him,
[✲]The One Possessor of strength. So He manifested His ascendance over everything,
w: so He manifested His ascendance over everything

verses.en: [✲]And He revealed His Word when he was on the uppermost horizon,
w: and He revealed His Word when he was

verses.en: Then he drew nearer to God; then he came down to mankind,
So that he became, as it were, one chord to two bows or closer still.
w: so that he became, as it were

verses.en: Then He revealed to His servant that which He revealed.
[✲]The heart of the Prophet was not untrue to that which he saw.
Will you then dispute with him about what he saw?
w: will you then dispute with him

verses.en: And certainly, he saw Him a second time also,
Near the farthest Lote-tree,
Near which is the Garden of Eternal Abode.
This was when that which covers covered the Lote-tree.
The eye deviated not, nor did it wander.

verses.ar: لَقَدۡ رَاٰی مِنۡ اٰیٰتِ رَبِّہِ الۡکُبۡرٰی ﴿۱۹﴾
verses.en: Surely, he saw the greatest of the Signs of his Lord.
Now tell me about Lat and ‘Uzza,[✛]
And Manat, the third one, another goddess!
‘What! for you the males and for Him the females!’
That indeed is an unfair division.

verses.ar: اِنۡ ہِیَ اِلَّاۤ اَسۡمَآءٌ سَمَّیۡتُمُوۡہَاۤ اَنۡتُمۡ وَاٰبَآؤُکُمۡ مَّاۤ اَنۡزَلَ اللّٰہُ بِہَا مِنۡ سُلۡطٰنٍ ؕ اِنۡ یَّتَّبِعُوۡنَ اِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَمَا تَہۡوَی الۡاَنۡفُسُ ۚ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَہُمۡ مِّنۡ رَّبِّہِمُ الۡہُدٰی ﴿ؕ۲۴﴾
verses.en: ‘These are but names which you have named — you and your fathers — for which Allah has sent down no authority.’ They follow naught but conjecture and what their souls desire, while there has already come to them guidance from their Lord.
w: there has already come to them

verses.en: [✲]Can man have whatever he desires?
[✲]Nay, to Allah belong the Hereafter and this world.

verses.ar: وَکَمۡ مِّنۡ مَّلَکٍ فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ لَا تُغۡنِیۡ شَفَاعَتُہُمۡ شَیۡئًا اِلَّا مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِ اَنۡ یَّاۡذَنَ اللّٰہُ لِمَنۡ یَّشَآءُ وَیَرۡضٰی ﴿۲۷﴾
verses.en: And how many an angel is there in the heavens, but their intercession shall be of no avail, except after Allah has given permission to whomsoever He wills and pleases.

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِیۡنَ لَا یُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِالۡاٰخِرَۃِ لَیُسَمُّوۡنَ الۡمَلٰٓئِکَۃَ تَسۡمِیَۃَ الۡاُنۡثٰی ﴿۲۸﴾
verses.en: Those who believe not in the Hereafter name the angels with names of females;

verses.ar: وَمَا لَہُمۡ بِہٖ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍ ؕ اِنۡ یَّتَّبِعُوۡنَ اِلَّا الظَّنَّ ۚ وَاِنَّ الظَّنَّ لَا یُغۡنِیۡ مِنَ الۡحَقِّ شَیۡئًا ﴿ۚ۲۹﴾
verses.en: But they have no knowledge thereof. They follow nothing but conjecture; and conjecture avails naught against truth.

verses.ar: فَاَعۡرِضۡ عَنۡ مَّنۡ تَوَلّٰی ۬ۙ عَنۡ ذِکۡرِنَا وَلَمۡ یُرِدۡ اِلَّا الۡحَیٰوۃَ الدُّنۡیَا ﴿ؕ۳۰﴾
verses.en: So turn aside from him who turns away from Our remembrance, and seeks nothing but the life of this world.

verses.ar: ذٰلِکَ مَبۡلَغُہُمۡ مِّنَ الۡعِلۡمِ ؕ اِنَّ رَبَّکَ ہُوَ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَنۡ ضَلَّ عَنۡ سَبِیۡلِہٖ ۙ وَہُوَ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ اہۡتَدٰی ﴿۳۱﴾
verses.en: [✲]That is the utmost limit of their knowledge. Verily, thy Lord knows him best who strays from His way, and He knows him best who follows guidance.

verses.ar: وَلِلّٰہِ مَا فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِی الۡاَرۡضِ ۙ لِیَجۡزِیَ الَّذِیۡنَ اَسَآءُوۡا بِمَا عَمِلُوۡا وَیَجۡزِیَ الَّذِیۡنَ اَحۡسَنُوۡا بِالۡحُسۡنٰی ﴿ۚ۳۲﴾
verses.en: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, that He may requite those who do evil for what they have wrought, and that He may reward with what is best those who do good.

verses.ar: اَلَّذِیۡنَ یَجۡتَنِبُوۡنَ کَبٰٓئِرَ الۡاِثۡمِ وَالۡفَوَاحِشَ اِلَّا اللَّمَمَ ؕ اِنَّ رَبَّکَ وَاسِعُ الۡمَغۡفِرَۃِ ؕ ہُوَ اَعۡلَمُ بِکُمۡ اِذۡ اَنۡشَاَکُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَرۡضِ وَاِذۡ اَنۡتُمۡ اَجِنَّۃٌ فِیۡ بُطُوۡنِ اُمَّہٰتِکُمۡ ۚ فَلَا تُزَکُّوۡۤا اَنۡفُسَکُمۡ ؕ ہُوَ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ اتَّقٰی ﴿٪۳۳﴾
verses.en: [✲]Those who shun the grave sins and immoral actions except minor faults — verily, thy Lord is very liberal in forgiving. He knows you full well from the time when He created you from the earth, and when you were embryos in the bellies of your mothers. So ascribe not purity to yourselves. He knows him best who is truly righteous.
Dost thou see him who turns away,
And gives a little, and does it grudgingly?
Has he the knowledge of the unseen so that he can see?

verses.ar: اَمۡ لَمۡ یُنَبَّاۡ بِمَا فِیۡ صُحُفِ مُوۡسٰی ﴿ۙ۳۷﴾
verses.en: Has he not been informed of what is in the Scriptures of Moses
And of Abraham who fulfilled the commandments? —
That no bearer of burden shall bear the burden of another;

verses.ar: وَاَنۡ لَّیۡسَ لِلۡاِنۡسَانِ اِلَّا مَا سَعٰی ﴿ۙ۴۰﴾
verses.en: [✲]And that man will have nothing but what he strives for;
[✲]And that his striving shall soon be seen;
Then will he be rewarded for it with the fullest reward;
w: will he be rewarded for it

verses.en: And that to thy Lord do all things ultimately go;
And that it is He Who makes men laugh and makes them weep;
And that it is He Who causes death and gives life;
And that He creates the pairs, male and female,
From a sperm-drop when it is poured forth;
And that it is for Him to bring forth the second creation;
And that it is He Who enriches and grants wealth to one’s satisfaction;
And that He is the Lord of Sirius;
And that He destroyed the first tribe of ‘Ad,
And the tribe of Thamud, and He spared not any of them,

verses.ar: وَقَوۡمَ نُوۡحٍ مِّنۡ قَبۡلُ ؕ اِنَّہُمۡ کَانُوۡا ہُمۡ اَظۡلَمَ وَاَطۡغٰی ﴿ؕ۵۳﴾
verses.en: And He destroyed the people of Noah before them — verily, they were most unjust and most rebellious —
[✲]And He overthrew the subverted cities of the people of Lot,
w: and the subverted cities of the people of Lot

verses.en: [✲]So that there covered them that which was to cover.
Which then, O man, of the bounties of thy Lord wilt thou dispute?
This is a Warner from among the class of the Warners of old.
The Hour that was to come has come nigh,

verses.ar: لَیۡسَ لَہَا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰہِ کَاشِفَۃٌ ﴿ؕ۵۹﴾
verses.en: None but Allah can avert it.
Do you then wonder at this announcement?
And do you laugh, and weep not?
And will you remain proudly heedless?
So prostrate yourselves before Allah, and worship Him.
